proposals.evidence: Turner dhūma includes Gujarati dhūvɔ/dhumāṛɔ and the Kachchhi dhū̃āṛo smoke addendum. These western Bhil/Malvi/Gojri forms fit that extended smoke-noun family with local ḍ/ḷ spellings. Forms with k or ṅ extensions are not automatically placed here.
